item.title: All Airports Are Ground Stopped Until Further Notice: FAA
item.content:encoded: "Balance of Power" focuses on the intersection of politics and global business. On today's show, Ray LaHood, former US Transportation Secretary, says he believes the nationwide FAA ground stop is more likely the result of an old, antiquated system failing than problems transitioning to new technology. item.title: Bloomberg Businessweek Daily Podcast: Jensen’s Nvidia Departure
item.content:encoded:
The people, companies and trends shaping the global economy. Watch Carol and Tim LIVE every day on YouTube: http://bit.ly/3vTiACF
After weeks spent denying the allegations of infidelity and fighting to remain in his job as Nvidia’s chief executive officer, Jensen Huang’s surrender late Wednesday night was unconditional. His usual take-charge demeanor had evaporated, according to a person familiar with the situation, and he’d started using phrases like “whatever” and “I don’t care.” Huang’s admittance to an affair with an alleged spy has had an international ripple effect across the AI and tech industry.
On today’s episode:
Ian King, Bloomberg News US Semiconductors Reporter Cat Barton, Bloomberg News Seoul Bureau Chief Joe Wiesenthal, Bloomberg ‘Odd Lots’ Podcast Co-Host Mark Jacobson, International Spy Museum Historian (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Ground Stop Fix Will 'Take Some Time,' Mullin Says
item.content:encoded: Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin says it will take some time to resolve issues affecting flights around the country. All flights have been grounded. He can't rule out the reason is a cyber attack, but he says travelers are safe. “It’s going to take some time, and so this isn’t going to just be resolved and turned around within the hour. This is going to take take some time,” he told reporters at the White House on Friday. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Jensen Huang Scandal Fallout Grows
item.content:encoded: A Chinese company founded by Alice Huang, the woman at the center of a controversy dogging Nvidia, procured smuggled AI chips that were installed at a Shanghai data center with links to Megaspeed International, according to documents reviewed by Bloomberg News. Bloomberg News Seoul Bureau Chief Cat Barton takes an international view of Jensen Huang’s downfall. Bloomberg News US Semiconductor Reporter Ian King also brings an exclusive inside look at Huang’s final hours as Nvidia CEO. Plus, Bloomberg News Technology Reporter Matt Day has the update and fallout of Microsoft’s massive services outage. Finally, Lis Agosto, Director of Product Research & Strategy at Global X ETFs, takes an investor’s view on the Nvidia scandal. (Source: Bloomberg)
